title: Content brief
hint: What the creator must include in the post. Separate with spaces, commas or lines.
agencyHint: The creator sees this brief next to the deliverables and checks each item before sending.

fields.linksHint: One per line, starting with https://
fields.referencesHint: Links to examples the brand likes (https://)
fields.dontsHint: E.g.: don't talk about price, don't show competitors
fields.checksHint: One per line. The brand checks them before approving.

checklist.talentHint: Tick each item. You can only send with everything checked.
checklist.brandHint: To approve, check every item. Requesting changes doesn't need it.
checklist.missing: {count, plural, one {# item left} other {# items left}}

brand.link_coupon: Correct link and coupon (when there are any)

checklist.donts: I did nothing from the “don'ts” list
checklist.recordedTalent: {count, plural, one {Creator checked # item} other {Creator checked # items}}
checklist.recordedBrand: {count, plural, one {Brand checked # advertising item} other {Brand checked # advertising items}}

templates.title: Start from a template
templates.hint: Templates keep objective, audience, deliverables and brief. No title, dates, creator or amount.
templates.dialogHint: Keeps objective, audience, deliverables and brief. No title, dates, creator or amount.
templates.nameHint: With the same name, the old template is replaced.
templates.deliverables: {count, plural, =0 {no deliverables} one {# deliverable} other {# deliverables}}

duplicate.done: Copy created. Adjust it and send whenever you want.
duplicate.confirmHint: Creates a new draft with brief, deliverables and audience. No dates, amount or status.
